name: Extruder Line
description: A foundation with an Extruder, a battery, a Materials Bin chuted into the hopper, a Cut-off Saw across its path and a timer on the saw: tip metal (or wood, planks, stone) into the bin and a 2 m bar drops off the end every 10 s. Set the shape on the Extruder, the length on the timer or the saw's Cut every.
